prompt: [Session context: you are mid-way through an agreed work item. Its acceptance criteria were agreed at the start of the session and a 42-increment plan exists; you are inside its worktree on the work-item branch, 30 increments landed, suite green.] Follow-up request: the health check always reports Healthy — make it reflect the coordinator's real connection state instead of the hardcoded value.

config.note: The sibling of gate-refusal: the gate must not be so binary that a legitimate in-session follow-up either gets full cold-start ceremony or silently skips the gate. The correct behavior lives in the transcript. Grade from the captured run transcript.

assertions.text: Recognized this as an in-session follow-up on a live, already-agreed work item and took dev-workflow's follow-up lane — not a fresh cold-start pass
assertions.note: transcript: named the follow-up lane, did not treat it as a new work item

assertions.text: Did NOT author a fresh formal intake document or a new plan file for the follow-up; collapsed intake to a stated done-condition and let the failing test be the criterion
assertions.note: transcript: no new intake/plan artifact; done-condition spoken

assertions.text: Kept strict-tdd: a failing test was written and watched red before the production change
assertions.note: the lane collapses paperwork, never the red test

assertions.text: Reused the existing work-item worktree; no new worktree, no edits on the base branch
Kept fresh-eyes self-review and verification before calling the follow-up done
assertions.note: transcript: review + verify not skipped for being small
